name: 江湖2006
group_note: ES2/jinyong-lineage mudlib (Annihilator/ShuJian derived), in-game titled 江湖2005/江湖2006 (书剑, Book & Sword theme). Bugs fixed: (1) classic §7.59 this_player()-clobbers-root bug in adm/daemons/securityd.lpc's valid_read() -- crashed immediately at boot with *Read access denied. inside logind.lpc's gb_big5()'s very first BAN_D->is_banned() lazy compile, before the id prompt ever appeared; fixed by exempting func=="load_object"/"include" from the this_player() override, matching the established pattern exactly; (2) classic §8.1 GBK byte-range is_chinese() bug plus check_legal_name()'s byte-doubled bounds (4/8 chars, i%2 gate -> 2/4 chars) in adm/daemons/logind.lpc; (3) classic §8.3b dead command-table sscanf in adm/daemons/commandd.lpc's rehash() -- "%s.c$" matched nothing after the .lpc rename, leaving the ENTIRE command table empty; look/quit happened to still work (defined via add_action elsewhere or driver-handled), but every other command including the score-equivalent (stscore, not score -- this lib doesn't use the word "score") fell straight through to "什么？" until fixed. Admin (fluffos/Mud2026Pass) seeded via real registration + adm/etc/wizlist, confirmed via visible 您目前的权限：(admin) display (auto-moved to 巫师休息室). Full registration->look->stscore->quit flow verified twice (before and after the LPC formatter pass) with a real Chinese name -- note the registration flow order is id -> y/N confirm -> password -> confirm password -> Chinese name -> gift stats -> gender, not the more common id -> confirm -> Chinese name -> password order seen in other libs.
